pages.text: This Panakeia has gained sanctity by being imbued with the power of the stars. It can be used as a material for the highest tier of alchemy kits and to strengthen ultra-rare metals such as Netherite. T7 Panakeia is created in the Transcendental Table.

pages.title: T6 Panakeia Material
pages.text: T6 Panakeia can strengthen these metals into T6 Panakeia Ingots.
